scope: Focused current-source equivalence/admission follow-through, not project execution or a whole audit wave.
proof_limits: These exact source comparisons cover the named bodies only. New error paths, fixtures and all connected P06 consumers still require complete source migration and hosted validation.
intentional_repairs: Missing edge-clamped physical support now returns the canonical TerrainSupportError through TerrainRecipeError rather than panicking.
Completed invalid fault-height candidates are rejected before native min/max reduction can hide them. Empty native scarp buffers fail explicitly.

FootClearanceFloor::minimum_height and ordinary_terrain_target check their completed floor before target.max. This intentionally rejects invalid completed floor arithmetic; it does not change finite expressions.

Completed native query points in Result-based foot/flight geometry operations reject nonfinite coordinates with the existing AnimationValueError::Overflow(WorldPosition), instead of manufacturing an available scene point. Real missing support remains None.
canonical_native_boundaries: Core sampled triangle computation receives ScenePlanPoint and projects only at its grid calculation.

Native erosion field returns its complete signed scalar equation to the actual marching sampler, which retains its existing finite-field/snap admission. This value is not an absolute support elevation forwarded between application APIs.
Scarp grid minimum remains ScenePlanPoint through its producer, retained cache, erosion and resistance constructor; the native resistance stencil projects it once for coordinate arithmetic.
Slope alignment application forwarders retain Dir3; only the complete rotation kernel receives the unchanged native vector.
Movement test Walker::on_colliders immediately constructs the actual Bevy Transform/collider fixture; its numerical inputs remain fixture/framework boundaries, not another application support query.
